protocol: All 32 repeatedly inspected development photos retained, with fixed 26 automatic crops and six unresolved crops. All three frozen projections compared visually as joint and residual readouts. Synthetic-control heads chosen for the full paired pipeline before real-photo inspection based on the synthetic printed-paper diagnostic. 10-second fitting allowances, rotated method order by photo. No checkpoint training, new labels, crop correction, classifier selection per photo, or altered acceptance gates.
result: No aggregate increase: both heads produce 11/32 complete editable candidates. Residual removes several joint-head classification defects but printing/reflection failures and inaccurate crop selections persist. Lower self-mask error is not artwork accuracy. The material classifier remains offline.

rootCauses.evidence: Bull, star, tentacled motif, candle and bird have fewer false holes/eroded border cells under residual fitting. The lobe RGB fit remains the base; neural context fits its remaining error. This is a qualitative paired-input observation, not annotated accuracy.

Similar red/white stripes and dots, mixed Christmas printing, and two white papers with dots/letters remain confused with material identity. Floral paper regresses because residual fitting restores printed detail suppressed by the joint head. Reflective gold remains badly classified.

Six fixed automatic crops are unresolved. The oblique basket and gold-building examples have clearly inappropriate fixed overlap selections. Cleaner material classification cannot repair those selections.

Four-small-hearts residual target has a passing alternate candidate from the joint search: 2.79625% error, full feature retention and engine geometry/paper pass. Its own fresh search returns 3.11625%. The joint candidate also passes editable conversion against its original target. Cross-target editable rendering has not been claimed.

Wolf targets differ by 1.379375% of pixels. The old candidate scores 2.988125% on its own mask and 3.64125% on the residual mask; the residual search returns 4.379375% on that new mask. Both geometry/paper audits and feature retention pass. Neither candidate meets 3% on the residual target.

Even visually adequate woman/birds, figure and bull masks lose important thin motif parts during fitting. Binary global error and broad feature checks do not certify intended original contours or physical assembly.

auditPreparationCorrection: The first cross-target audit omitted the explicit observation weights that preprocessing attaches to a partial crop. The self-replay assertion detected missing weightMass metadata. Restoring Float64 observation weights made all 52 self error/feature reports exact; no candidate, mask, production code or gate changed.
limitations: One timed fit per classifier/photo is not a stable estimate of search variance.
No held-out real-photo accuracy estimate; this development cohort has been repeatedly inspected.
Self-mask error may improve while the intended artwork worsens. No original cutting paths are available for these cases.
The learned projections were trained for joint fitting, not this residual readout. No neural weights were changed in this study.
This is headless production conversion and SVG I/O replay, not a new browser interaction test or physical assembly.
next: Train a matched residual-readout continuation using the existing source-separated training inputs and fixed updates, paired against unchanged joint continuation. Retain the radial cohort as diagnostic and repeat the complete real-photo/export gate. Separately use the preserved four-small-hearts pair to study search sensitivity without altering its target.
